title: R’ Oshaya, son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is thus mentioned in Yevamot 36b: “Rav Ashi said to him.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read “Rav Yehoshua son of Rav Idi,” as cited there on 37a in Rashi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The correction from Oshaya to Rav Yehoshua is Hyman’s, citing Rashi at Yevamot 37a.

William Davidson Yevamot 36b reads Rav Hoshaya son of Rav Idi, addressed by Rav Ashi. The whole Vilna Rashi comment at 37a reads לר׳ יהושע בריה דרב אידי, with the first title abbreviated. Hyman’s fully written Rav Yehoshua and his ‘should read’ remain his proposed correction. Neither digital reading repairs the supplied Hebrew or proves a printed correction history.
